hypotheses: h and h_star are coprime odd fundamental discriminants of opposite infinite sign, with k=h*h_star<-4.
Every prime dividing 2N splits in K; source h and h_star have the same unit squareclasses there.
ell is an odd good prime not dividing 2N*h*h_star, inert in K, ell=3 mod 4, and chi_h_star(ell)=-sigma; the source detecting filter also has chi_h(ell)=sigma.
B is ramified exactly at ell and infinity, and R is an Eichler order of level N.
Use the declared Schwartz weights, including the integral generator at two, nilpotent determinant sign at q|h_star, and residue trace-zero-line sign at ell.
After a fixed L kills cuspidal constants, the reduced parametrization has right t_p eigenvalue w_(p^e) for p^e||N and right ell-uniformizer eigenvalue sigma in the coefficient module.
Use linear reduction/Kummer evaluation and the unnormalized conductor-one genus sum.
Use ideal-action-equivariant oriented CM reduction with the chosen level tuple and a fixed inert residue-field identification, specialized to conductor one and multiplicity one.

steps_supported: Nilpotent determinant-character descent cancels the right order-unit norm character; rational reduced norms are positive, giving left rational invariance.
The norm pullback of chi_h_star descends to Pic(O_K) and is the unramified genus character of K(sqrt(h_star))/K.
A split cyclic p^e level has exactly two types, including p=2 with the full integral quadratic generator; the inert division prime has exactly two residue orientations.
Each global orientation fiber is K^times\Khat^times/O_Khat^times, with termwise genus weights retained.
Exact optimal-embedding stabilizer {+1,-1} gives integer mass c0/2 after denominators are cleared.
Right normalizers commute with the left ideal action; the local Schwartz, parametrization and norm-character factors multiply to one in each orientation switch.
The orientation sum is (c0/2)*2^(omega(N)+1), giving c0*2^omega(N).
A uniform unit bound of 81 permits c0=lcm(1,...,81); fixed cuspidal constants permit L independent of the number of ideal classes.
Kummer evaluation at arithmetic Frobenius squared is equivariant for arithmetic Frobenius, giving the stated sigma law without an additional degree factor.
conditional_proof.hypothesis_warning: Inertness alone does not force the individual sign chi_h_star(ell)=-sigma. Conductor one, maximality, and the fixed residue orientation are essential.
conditional_proof.integer_lift_warning: The general module identity uses covariance in that module. Arbitrary integer lifts of the source values need not have characteristic-zero covariance.
